artworks.title: Puncah Chief Surrounded by His Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing wrapped in an animal-skin robe with intricate patterns. They are standing upright with one arm resting on the shoulder of another figure, while the other arm is slightly raised. The person has visible facial features with high cheekbones, wide-set eyes, and long dark hair falling over their shoulders. Several tipis are visible in the background, arranged in a semi-circle in a grassy area. On the left, another figure stands beside a small dog, holding a stick with feathers. Other people and a couple of animals are present in the camp, set against a softly painted sky nearing dusk.

artworks.title: Ottowa Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are standing side by side. The central figure has short black hair with feathers, wears a garment around the waist, and holds a staff adorned with feathers and tassels. The person on the left has long black hair and is wrapped in a light-colored blanket-like garment. The individual on the right is also wrapped in a blanket, exposing one arm, and has long dark hair. The background includes a soft pastel sky, greenery at their feet, and is framed within a larger neutral-toned mat.

artworks.title: Mohigan Chief and a Missionary
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left is upright, holding a staff, with a stern expression, wearing a feathered headdress, a knee-length garment with a sash, and decorative trim. The individual on the right is seated on a rock, holding a folded piece of paper, with sharp eyes, short dark hair, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, red sash, and boots. The background includes an open grassy landscape with rocks and a blue sky with clouds. The scene is framed within an oval shape, bordered by a rectangle.

artworks.title: Nine Ojibbeway Indians in London
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

Some have long hair with feathers and headdresses, and wear elaborate clothing with patterns, fringes, necklaces, and beadwork. They hold items such as a feathered staff and arrows. The background is a soft, muted blend of earth tones. The image is bordered ovally.

artworks.title: Oneida Chief, His Sister, and a Missionary
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side in a landscape setting. The person on the far left is wrapped in a light-colored cloak with embroidered edges and long, dark hair. The middle person wears a light-colored cloak with embroidery, a feathered headdress, and holds a tomahawk. The individual on the right wears a dark long coat tied at the waist with a red sash, light-colored pants, and moccasin-like footwear, with short, dark, styled hair. Each individual is adorned in clothing with intricate patterns. The background is a softly rendered natural landscape with clouds in a light-colored sky and hints of greenery.

artworks.title: Three Delaware Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing upright facing forward. The person on the left is dressed in a light-colored garment with a pattern, likely a shawl or blanket, with dark hair showing underneath. The individual in the center wears a fur-like outfit with fringes and patterns, holding a pipe. The person on the right is also dressed in fur-like attire with a pipe in hand, dark hair, and a feather ornament in their hair. They are set against a landscape background with earth tones, a blue sky with light clouds, grass, and patches of ground. The frame is in green and beige.

artworks.title: Three Creek Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing side by side outdoors. The person on the left has long dark hair tied back, wearing a pink dress and moccasins. The individual in the center has dark hair with a headdress, wearing a light brown garment with red sashes. The person on the right has short dark hair, wearing a dark coat with a red sash, holding a hat. The background shows a blue sky with distant hills.

artworks.title: Two Choctaw Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image includes two seated figures, both shown from the knees up. Each person is seated with their legs bent and feet resting on the ground. The individual on the left has dark hair with feathers and wears a long garment with a pattern across the chest and over the shoulders. Their garment reaches the knees, revealing moccasin-style footwear. This person holds an object in their hand, which appears to be a feather fan or similar item. The figure on the right also has dark hair with feathers and wears a long-sleeve top with a decorative sash, knee-length leggings, and moccasins. The background shows an open landscape with green plains, rocks, and a cloudy sky, suggesting an outdoor setting. The image is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Two Weeah Warriors and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted standing in a landscape setting. Each person has distinct facial features and feathered hair. The person on the left wears a long brown tunic and holds a bow and arrow. The middle person wears a feathered headdress, a poncho, and fur on one shoulder while holding a pipe and a pouch. The person on the right wears a light tunic with a red robe draped over their shoulders and a feathered headband. The background shows a sky with light clouds and an earthen ground. The scene is inside an oval frame with a border, suggesting it is part of a larger collection or display.

artworks.title: Seminolee Indians, Prisoners at Fort Moultrie
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a group of eight people, five adults and three children, on a grassy ground. Four are seated, with the other four standing behind them. On the left appear to be four men, two sitting and two standing. Three of them hold long rifles, while one holds a long, thin pipe. They all wear colorful headbands or headdresses adorned with long feathers over their long black hair. Next to them is a seated person without a headband who may be a woman. She has an infant in her arms, laying in a large basket with a handle. Behind the woman is another child who touches the woman's dark hair. On the far right, an older child stands, facing the right, with one tall feather in their hair. The two visible children wear tunics, while the adults are wrapped in long tan garments, some of which are decorated with bright red designs. The two seated men on the left also wear bright yellow sashes with red and green designs on them. Many of the people are wearing colorful necklaces and earrings, and on their feet are tan shoes. The adults and the oldest child have red markings on their faces around their ears, and the child has circular designs adorning their arms, shoulder, and torso. All of the people have tan skin. Behind them, the sky is a pastel mix of pale pink and blue. The painting is surrounded by an oval border, beyond which is plain beige paper and a light green frame.

artworks.title: Osceola and Four Seminolee Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: There is a group of five people in the image. In the center, a person stands holding a gun with elaborate facial paint and feathers in their hair, wearing a fringed tunic and moccasins. To their left, another individual sits in a cloak and feathered headdress. A woman on the left holds a baby, and two figures are seated on the right. The background shows a softly painted outdoor scene with a pale sky. The image is framed in an oval matte within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Two Cherokee Chiefs
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left wears a long, quilted coat and pants, with short, dark hair and a feathered stuff. The individual on the right holds a long rifle, wearing fringed attire including a tunic, belt, leggings, and moccasins. Both people have light brown skin and dark hair styled with feathered headbands. The background includes flat green grass and a blue-gray sky. The painting is framed in a black oval border, beyond which is a tan border and then a pale-blue border.

artworks.title: Kickapoo Indians Preaching and Praying
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Three Potowotomie Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three Native American figures are standing on grassy ground. The person on the left is female, wearing a dress and holding a cylindrical object. The central figure is a male with one hand on his hip and the other raised to his chest, wearing a fringed cloak. The male figure on the right is standing with his arms folded, wearing a robe and traditional moccasins. The background displays a cloudy sky with hues of yellow and green.

artworks.title: Shawano Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows five people standing together in a grassy area. On the left, a man and a woman stand next to each other. On the right are two more men with two small boys visible between them. All of the people have tan skin and black hair. The children are naked, but the adults wear fabrics wrapped around them in shades of cream and light brown, with tan trousers underneath. The three men wear feathered headdress decorated with detailed, colorful designs over their black hair. They also wear jewelry, such as multiple strands of colorful beaded necklaces, hooped earrings, and silver arm bands. The two men on the right have elongated earlobes, and the man on the far right has three arrows sticking through the hole. He also holds a strand of beads in one hand and a thin branch in the other that appears to have a small flame on its top. The central man holds a long object with red fibers sticking out of it, and his bare torso is covered in thin, black, horizontal lines. The man on the left holds a rifle. The people stand on green grass, and the background features soft blue-and-pink skies. The scene is bordered by an oval frame surrounded by blank beige paper and a pale green border.

artworks.title: A K'nisteneux Warrior and Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a full-body portrait outdoors. The person in the center stands upright, holding a long, decorated staff. His hair is long, dark, and adorned with colorful feathers and beads. He wears a richly decorated garment with fringes and vibrant patterns, as well as a pair of moccasins. To his right stands a young male child, who is also upright and carries a small bow and arrows. The child's hair is long and unadorned. The child appears to be wearing minimal clothing. To the left of the central figure is a female, wearing a long dress with intricate beadwork and fringe. Her long hair is dark and straight, and she stands with her hands lightly resting by her sides. They are situated on a grassy plain, and in the background, there are two tipis with figures seated near them. The sky is open and light, suggesting a cloudy day.

artworks.title: Three Micmac Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures of Native American individuals. To the left stands a woman wrapped in a light-colored shawl, holding a small child on her back. The woman's hair is parted down the middle, and she wears a long turquoise dress and red shoes. In the center stands a man wearing a headdress with feathers, earrings, and several necklaces. He is dressed in a dark green outfit with decorative trim and red accents, and he holds a long rifle in his right hand. This man's face is adorned with red paint around his eyes. To the right, another man sits cross-legged on the ground, wearing a feathered headdress similar to the standing man. His attire is grey with decorative elements, and he holds a tomahawk in his hands. The background is an open landscape with a predominantly light blue sky and clouds. The image is framed by an oval border set within a larger rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Yntah Medicine Man, a Warrior, and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three figures are shown standing side by side. The first person on the left wears a cape featuring human-like figures and fringes, with long dark hair and feathers. The middle person wears a fur outfit with a feathered headpiece, holding a bow and arrows, and adorned with bracelets. The person on the right wears a light shawl with a pink border and jewelry, standing with bare arms. The background shows a vast open landscape in blue and beige tones.

artworks.title: Three Celebrated Ball Players - Choctaw, Sioux and Ojibbeway
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: An Ojibbeway Village of Skin Tents
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a Native American camp from an elevated viewpoint. The scene includes tipis with symbols and people engaged in various activities. The setting features distant hills under a cloudy sky, with soft transitions between land and sky. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, creating a realistic landscape. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones, with greens for hills and browns for tipis and earth, while the sky is a blend of grays and blues. Figures on horseback in the distance add movement to the scene. The painting is bordered by an oval frame.

artworks.title: Buffalo Chase in the Snow Drifts - Ojibbeway
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a snow-covered landscape with a herd of dark bison scattered across it. Two figures in fur garments are crouched near one of the bison. The terrain includes soft, rolling hills with snow-dusted bushes. The color palette is primarily white and blue with hints of dark brown and a pale blue sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the snow and fur textures.
